head: Rap1-mediated integrin activation
name: Rap1-mediated integrin activation (endothelial shear stress, platelet activation, PIEZO1)
rationale: Members converge on Rap1-driven inside-out integrin activation and its cytoskeletal coupling; the shear-stress and platelet contexts separate it from the Rho/focal-adhesion, leukocyte-adhesion and platelet-GPCR neighbours.

head: Neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling
name: Neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling (TRKA, TRKC, Ras-MAPK-CREB)
rationale: All members are effector branches of TRK neurotrophin receptors; naming TRKA and TRKC with Ras-MAPK-CREB outputs separates it from the TRKB/BDNF and NGF-activation/retrograde neighbours.

head: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and turnover
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and turnover (PC/PE/PS, PG-cardiolipin, lysophospholipid hydrolysis)
rationale: Members build PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP routes and degrade lysophospholipids, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on acyl-chain remodelling, PI synthesis/transport and endocannabinoids.

head: Cardiac impulse conduction
name: Cardiac impulse conduction (depolarization, SA node pacemaking, gap junction coupling)
rationale: Members cover depolarization and electrical spread through nodal, His-Purkinje and working myocardium, unlike neighbours on repolarization/potassium channels or conduction-system development.

head: Kidney epithelial polarity and specialization
name: Kidney epithelial polarity and specialization (brush border, tight junctions, podocyte slit diaphragm)
rationale: Members establish apical-basal polarity and its specializations in tubular and glomerular epithelium, separating it from apical trafficking, glomerular vasculature/mesangium and adherens-junction neighbours.

head: Endocannabinoid metabolism and signaling
name: Endocannabinoid metabolism and signaling (anandamide, 2-AG, retrograde synaptic signaling)
rationale: Members make and degrade N-acylethanolamines and 2-AG and use them as retrograde synaptic lipid messengers, distinct from the eicosanoid, histamine and leukotriene neighbours.

head: Axon pathfinding
name: Axon pathfinding (midline crossing, chemorepulsion, neuron-type-specific tracts)
rationale: Members guide axons of commissural, retinal, dopaminergic and serotonergic neurons through repulsive and midline cues, rather than the SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin or semaphorin signalling detail held by neighbours.

head: Cullin neddylation and deneddylation
name: Cullin neddylation and deneddylation (COP9 signalosome, CUL1 substrate degradation)
rationale: Members form the NEDD8 on/off cycle that controls cullin-RING ligases, distinct from neighbours on deubiquitination, ubiquitin chain types and PD-L1 degradation.

head: Restraint of VEGF-driven angiogenic sprouting
name: Restraint of VEGF-driven angiogenic sprouting (Tie2, endothelial survival, adherens junctions)
rationale: Members hold endothelium quiescent by limiting VEGFR2-driven sprouting while Tie2 supports survival and junctions, unlike the pro-angiogenic, cell-matrix and VEGF-production neighbours.

head: Nuclear RNA export
name: Nuclear RNA export (mRNA, tRNA, ribosomal subunits)
rationale: Members move mature RNAs and pre-ribosomes out through the nuclear pore, separating it from the RNA processing, decay and nuclear pore assembly/protein-import neighbours.

head: Transcription elongation and termination
name: Transcription elongation and termination (RNA polymerase I, RNA polymerase III, early rRNA processing)
rationale: Members are the elongation and termination steps of Pol I and Pol III transcription plus 5'-ETS processing, distinct from neighbours on initiation and rRNA regulation.

head: Blood coagulation and fibrinolysis
name: Blood coagulation and fibrinolysis (common pathway, fibrin formation, factor V defects)
rationale: Members form and dissolve fibrin clots via the common pathway with factor V variants, unlike neighbours on the intrinsic/FXII contact pathway, factor VIII/IX defects or VWF.

head: Monoamine neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter metabolism and transport (catecholamines, serotonin, sympathoadrenal development)
rationale: Members synthesize, package, reuptake and degrade catecholamines and serotonin, with sympathoadrenal development separating it from the broader neurotransmitter-transport and dopamine-receptor neighbours.

head: Platelet activation
name: Platelet activation (cytoskeletal remodeling)
rationale: The three expression modules capture platelet activation with its cytoskeletal reorganization, unlike neighbours on fibroblast matrix adhesion and integrin-Rap1 signalling.

head: Glycine-centred amino acid metabolism
name: Glycine-centred amino acid metabolism (threonine, proline, aromatic acid conjugation)
rationale: Members make and degrade glycine (via threonine and glyoxylate), handle proline and use glycine or glutamine to conjugate aromatic acids, distinct from sulfur/aromatic, glutamate and alanine neighbours.

head: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis
name: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis (p53, BCL-2 family, apoptosome)
rationale: Members run the p53-induced BCL-2 family decision, cytochrome c release and apoptosome-caspase activation, distinct from p53 cell-cycle/senescence and apoptosis-execution neighbours.

head: PLC-IP3 calcium signaling
name: PLC-IP3 calcium signaling (G protein-coupled receptors, noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+, LPA receptors)
rationale: Members raise cytosolic calcium through phospholipase C and IP3 downstream of GPCRs and Wnt/Ca2+, separating it from cAMP, PKC, eicosanoid-receptor and purinergic neighbours.

head: Glutamate reuptake
name: Glutamate reuptake (astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycle)
rationale: Members clear synaptic glutamate into astrocytes for recycling via glutamine, distinct from monoamine, GABA and aspartate transporter neighbours.

head: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
rationale: All members export processed mRNAs from the nucleus, distinct from neighbours on mRNA processing and nuclear pore complex organization.

head: Gastrulation and germ layer formation
name: Gastrulation and germ layer formation (definitive endoderm, lateral mesoderm, early gut)
rationale: Members cover exit from pluripotency, primitive streak EMT and germ-layer specification through early gut morphogenesis, unlike the heart and pancreas development neighbours.

head: Pyroptotic cell death execution
name: Pyroptotic cell death execution (gasdermin pores, pyroptosis defects)
rationale: Members are the lytic execution of pyroptosis and its defects, downstream of the inflammasome assembly held by neighbours.

head: JNK stress-activated kinase cascade activation
name: JNK stress-activated kinase cascade activation
rationale: All members positively regulate the JNK stress kinase cascade, distinct from NF-kappaB, NOD and TAK1-upstream neighbours.

head: DNA structural remodeling in genome maintenance
name: DNA structural remodeling in genome maintenance (topology, fork reversal, protein-DNA disassembly)
rationale: Members change DNA topology and structure during replication and repair, unlike neighbours on chromatin remodelling, telomere maintenance or replication stress.

head: Synapse assembly and receptor clustering
name: Synapse assembly and receptor clustering (neurexin-neuroligin, NMDA/PSD-95, GABA/gephyrin)
rationale: Members build pre- and postsynaptic membranes and cluster excitatory and inhibitory receptors, distinct from neighbours on SALM and receptor phosphatase synaptic adhesion.

head: Type 2 eosinophilic inflammation
name: Type 2 eosinophilic inflammation (Th2 differentiation, IL-5, eosinophil recruitment)
rationale: Members promote Th2 cells and IL-5 that drive eosinophil migration and activation, unlike neighbours on negative Th2 regulation, IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signalling or granulocyte differentiation.
